description: Sample test cases for classifying patient symptoms by medical urgency.

test_cases.input: I have severe chest pain and difficulty breathing.
I have a severe headache that started suddenly.
My face suddenly started drooping, but now it seems normal.
I am having suicidal thoughts and have a plan to act on them.
I have heavy bleeding during pregnancy.
I have a high fever and persistent vomiting.
I am experiencing a new fever and I have a weakened immune system.
My child has had a persistent fever for several days.
I developed a mild rash after taking a new medication.
I have had mild nasal congestion since yesterday.
I want to know which vitamins are good for general health.
I have a mild headache that feels similar to headaches I have experienced before.
I feel unwell.
Something is wrong with my body.
I have been feeling strange lately, but I cannot explain what is happening.
My three-week-old baby has a temperature of 38 degrees Celsius.
My throat is swelling and I am struggling to breathe after eating peanuts.
I have moderate abdominal pain that is getting worse.
My elderly father suddenly became confused and is not behaving normally.
I have had mild sneezing and a runny nose for one day.

note: Educational test dataset only. Expected labels are illustrative and must be reviewed by qualified healthcare professionals before clinical use.
